covered.title: Build Momentum: Raise Transfer Start Rate from 35% to 45%
covered.summary: Q3 coaching focus on firm next steps and urgency to improve transfer start rate.

covered.title: Failed Direct Deposit: Print a Paper Check While Funds Clear
covered.summary: Manage Payment now offers paper-check printing while a blocked refund completes.

covered.title: Admin Shows Current and Future-Dated Payroll Packages
covered.summary: Admin distinguishes current and scheduled payroll packages and displays future effective dates.

covered.title: Check Refile Requests Can Stay Blocked During Recollection
covered.source: CS Ops / Check workflow guidance approved by Sarah
covered.summary: Refile requests remain blocked until Check recollects funds, then sync automatically.

covered.title: Payroll Pricing Experiment Expands to 100%
covered.source: Internal pricing experiment update approved by Sarah
covered.summary: Payroll pricing experiment expanded to its full intended audience.

covered.title: IMP Calendly Selector Moves to Front of Wizard
covered.summary: Follow-up: the IMP Calendly selector moves to the front of the wizard July 23.

covered.title: Schedule Builder Agent Starts with a 1,000-Customer Beta
covered.summary: Follow-up to Issue 18: Schedule Builder Agent begins with a stratified cohort of about 1,000 customers before the broader P1 rollout.

covered.title: New Safeguards When a Payroll Bank Account Changes
covered.summary: Default-account changes can update open draft payrolls, while Homebase can promote a usable account when the old default fails.

covered.title: Employee Onboarding Packets Get a Designbase Refresh
covered.summary: Employee-facing web packets get a Designbase visual refresh without changing fields, requirements, or submission logic.

covered.title: Business Insurance Gets a Homebase Hub—and General Liability
covered.summary: An owner-only ERGO NEXT hub surfaces pay-as-you-go Workers’ Comp for eligible payroll customers and General Liability for payroll and non-payroll owners.

covered.title: Custom Payroll Reports Now Arrive by Email
covered.summary: Saved Custom Reports generate in the background, continue downloading in-browser, and also arrive by email.

covered.title: Mobile Adds a Biometric Sign-In Reminder
covered.summary: Follow-up: an optional employee Dashboard card will accelerate discovery of Face ID, Touch ID, and fingerprint sign-in.

covered.title: Score, Coach, and Start Strong
covered.source: Sarah Manning / Gong, Google Calendar, and Salesforce
covered.summary: SE reminder to use the updated SPICED scorecard, book MasterCraft coaching, and track Transfer Start Legends in Salesforce.

covered.title: Right-Time Calling Reps: Action the Banner and Surface Blockers
covered.summary: Follow-up: pilot reps should action Online Now banners, surface blockers, and avoid claiming an unproven connect-rate lift.

covered.title: Time Card Review Assistant: A Sneak Peek at What’s Coming
covered.summary: A very limited web beta previews a clearer Daily Review and resolution flow for four pay-impacting time-card issue types.

covered.title: Payroll Now Explains Multi-Rate Overtime Calculations
covered.summary: The weighted-wage modal now shows role-specific overtime rates and expandable calculation details for multi-rate weeks.

covered.title: Payroll Summary Adds Taxable-Wage Columns
covered.summary: An optional Payroll Summary checkbox adds per-tax, wage-base-limited taxable-wage columns to the CSV.

covered.title: Spring Payroll Promo Closes at $117K in New MRR
covered.summary: The expired three-month-free promo converted 4,991 opportunities and highlighted deadline urgency, video, and cost framing as winning approaches.

covered.title: Payroll Base Price Is Planned to Increase from $39 to $49
covered.summary: The Payroll base price point for impacted existing customers is planned to increase from $39 to $49, with Marketing targeting September 2 and coordinated CX and Sales churn-response enablement planned first.

covered.title: Download an Individual Employee’s Current-Year Draft W-2
covered.summary: Employers can generate one employee’s current-year draft W-2 in-browser from Team → W-2s and 1099s.

covered.title: Autopayroll Reminders Now Flag Timecards Needing Review
covered.summary: Upcoming-submission reminders now show open timecard counts, issue types, and a direct review action.

covered.title: Roles & Wages Redesign Starts with New Companies
covered.summary: A controlled first phase gives about 1% of new companies a simpler, effective-dated roles and wages experience.
